description: Source code for the 'app' package in the focalboard server, defining the main application structure, dependencies, and initialization functions.

classes.name: Services
classes.description: Holds various service dependencies such as authentication, storage, webhook, metrics, notifications, logger, permissions, and API interface.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct managing configuration, dependencies, and runtime state, including methods for configuration management, card limit control, and license retrieval.

methods.name: GetLicense
